claims.claim_text: Support for regional movements against existing nation-state authorities may, in some cases, serve a critical purpose in fighting imperialism.
When exploited working people join their powers against state oppression, they can build among themselves the potential for liberation and democracy.
The potential for liberation and democracy built by exploited working people joining against state oppression is only realized through rejecting nationalism or a new imperialism.
The Libertarian Socialist Caucus's support for regional movements against existing nation-state authorities is neither universal nor uncritical.
Many regional movements seek a non-liberatory end or center the subjugation of marginalized communities in their pursuit of separatism.
Movements upholding libertarian socialism or radical democracy provide the most liberating vision in regions facing imperial exploitation.
Socialist alignment is not a precondition for support for liberatory action, as in solidarity with the Palestinian people in their struggle against Zionist aggression.
The Libertarian Socialist Caucus affirms itself as an explicitly anti-Zionist formation.
Members who tangibly support Zionist causes have no place in DSA.
DSA is an organization opposed to imperialism and genocide.
